arguments.command:
python -c "
from collections import defaultdict
d = defaultdict(int, {'a': 1})
print('factory:', d.default_factory)
items = [(k, v) for k, v in d.items() if k != 'a']
print('items:', items)
new_d = defaultdict(d.default_factory, items)
print('new_d:', new_d)
"
